description: Pale stone and cold light. The Halcyon seal, a calm eye over a skyline, is inlaid ten metres wide in the floor. Frosted glass reads ASSURANCE FOR THE ASSURED. A bank of brushed-steel elevators serves the fifties and up: the arcade, the underwriting and claims halls, the sky residences and the executive suite. Step in to ride. Two windows serve the floor. There's always a queue at the first one.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
